crossRefs.note: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Yahweh my God, I will give thanks to you forever!
So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all…
I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.
While I live, I will praise Yahweh. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.
Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

translations.web: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.
translations.bsb: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
translations.kjv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
translations.asv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, That I may daily perform my vows. Psalm 62 For the Chief Musician; after the manner of Jeduthan. A Psalm of David.
